acceptance.reason: Root and relaykit vet/build passed, and the CI workflow creates all three embed placeholder paths.

The root Go suite fails when the channel-affinity relay-format tests run together: time-based test identities allow cache-key contamination, although each test passes alone. make is also unavailable on this Windows host. This is a reproducible test-isolation gap requiring a Build fix.

Frontend typecheck, tests, and production build pass, but repository-wide lint reports thousands of pre-existing classic/default errors outside the CI placeholder candidate; affected wallet files are lint-clean.
The i18n sync report records zero missing and extra keys for every locale, with existing fallback untranslated values documented.
Router, middleware, controller, and focused auth/groupbuy/wallet evidence covers the documented route and permission boundaries.
Focused wallet, payment, groupbuy, authentication, video/material, and channel-monitor regression tests passed in the recorded candidate checks.
The maintenance status document separates local acceptance, online merchant acceptance, and paused WeChat login work, and includes the administrator credential, callback, and live payment checklist.

risks: The second independent verifier execution remained running without a response; the first fallback verifier failed with 429 Too Many Requests.
The test-isolation correction and any decision about repository-wide frontend lint remain unresolved; do not Archive.
